comparison.sample_pairing: first sample per browser is used for field comparison; all three within-version samples are separately checked for normalized/detailed ClientHello equality and normalized HTTP/2 fingerprint equality
comparison.clienthello: Exact comparison of normalized_clienthello and detailed_clienthello. Raw TLS records remain in captures. Normalization removes ephemeral random/session/key-share/SNI/ECH/padding bytes; GREASE values and Chrome extension permutations are normalized; conditional padding extension 21 is excluded. The raw extension-order and payload-size observations below are not normalized away.
comparison.http2: Same fingerprint algorithm as tests/test_browser_profiles.py: decoded ordered header fields with only :authority replaced by <origin>; ACK frames excluded as scheduling-dependent; ALPN, TLS version, SETTINGS, window updates, non-HEADERS frame payload/order/stream IDs/flags and header order retained. Raw received_hex remains in captures.
comparison.limitations: Three fresh-profile samples per browser/mode describe these runs; they do not establish population-wide browser behavior.
